name: Breakfast with Santa
cost: $26.95 per person; $7.95 children 24 months and younger
raw: {"title": "Breakfast with Santa", "start": "2026-12-12 09:00:00", "end": "2026-12-20 12:00:00", "venue": "Magnolia Cafe & Bakery", "cost": "", "categories": ["Breakfast with Santa"], "desc": " Santa Claus is coming to town!
